title: HSK 2.17 · 春天, 阴天, 春节, 音乐会
focus: 请求 · 准确 · 碗 · 夏天 · 有意思 · 冬天 · 节日 · 特点 · 阴 · 半夜 · 春天 · 天上 · 路边 · 点头 · 夜里 · 音乐会 · 秋天 · 海边 · 晴 · 里头 · 请客 · 日报 · 有点儿 · 干杯 · 晴天 · 那会儿 · 一路顺风 · 晚报 · 问路 · 音节 · 一点点 · 春节 · 阴天 · 读音 · 一路平安 · 不一会儿 · 干活儿 · 不太 · 画儿
body:
The four seasons (春天, 夏天, 秋天, 冬天), weather (阴, 晴), and sound words built on 音 (音乐会, 音节, 读音). Several erhua words (有点儿, 画儿) end in a curled r.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 天 | tiān | sky; day; season | 夏天, 冬天, 春天, 秋天, 天上, 晴天, 阴天 |
| 音 | yīn | sound | 音乐会, 音节, 读音 |
| 节 | jié | festival; section | 节日, 音节, 春节 |
| 点 | diǎn | dot, point; a bit | 特点, 点头, 有点儿, 一点点 |
| 请 | qǐng | to ask, invite | 请求, 请客 |
| 报 | bào | newspaper | 日报, 晚报 |
| 夜 | yè | night | 半夜, 夜里 |
| 儿 | r | erhua ending (adds an r sound) | 有点儿, 那会儿, 不一会儿, 干活儿, 画儿 |

## Watch out

- 干 is gān (dry) in 干杯 but gàn (do) in 干活儿.
- 阴 (阝 + 月 moon, overcast) is the mirror of 阳 (阝 + 日 sun).
- 晴 qíng (sunny, 日) vs 请 qǐng (please, 讠) vs 情 qíng (feeling, 忄): same 青 sound part.

cards.Example: 我有一个请求。 wǒ yǒu yí ge qǐngqiú: I have a favor to ask.
cards.Notes: 请 ask politely + 求 beg, seek

cards.Example: 他说得很准确。 tā shuō de hěn zhǔnquè: He put it exactly right.
cards.Notes: 准 accurate + 确 certain

cards.Example: 再来一碗饭。 zài lái yì wǎn fàn: Another bowl of rice, please.
cards.Notes: 石 stone (stoneware) + 宛 wǎn (phonetic)

cards.Example: 夏天太热了。 xiàtiān tài rè le: Summer is too hot.
cards.Notes: 夏 summer + 天 season

cards.Example: 这本书很有意思。 zhè běn shū hěn yǒuyìsi: This book is really interesting.
cards.Notes: 有 have + 意思 meaning = has meaning

cards.Example: 冬天很冷。 dōngtiān hěn lěng: Winter is cold.
cards.Notes: 冬 winter (bottom ⺀ is ice) + 天 season

cards.Example: 你最喜欢什么节日？ nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme jiérì: What's your favorite holiday?
cards.Notes: 节 festival + 日 day

cards.Example: 这个城市有什么特点？ zhège chéngshì yǒu shénme tèdiǎn: What's special about this city?
cards.Notes: 特 special + 点 point

cards.Example: 天阴了。 tiān yīn le: It's clouded over.
cards.Notes: 阝 hill + 月 moon: the shady side; mirror of 阳 (阝 + 日 sun)

cards.Example: 他半夜才回来。 tā bànyè cái huílai: He didn't get back till midnight.
cards.Notes: 半 half + 夜 night

cards.Example: 春天花都开了。 chūntiān huā dōu kāi le: In spring the flowers all bloom.
cards.Notes: 春 spring (bottom is 日 sun) + 天 season

cards.Example: 天上有很多星星。 tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō xīngxing: There are lots of stars in the sky.
cards.Notes: 天 sky + 上 on, up

cards.Example: 他在路边等我。 tā zài lùbiān děng wǒ: He's waiting for me by the road.
cards.Notes: 路 road + 边 side

cards.Example: 她笑着点头。 tā xiàozhe diǎntóu: She nodded with a smile.
cards.Notes: 点 dip, dot + 头 head = dip the head

cards.Example: 夜里下雨了。 yèli xià yǔ le: It rained during the night.
cards.Notes: 夜 night + 里 in

cards.Example: 我们去听音乐会吧。 wǒmen qù tīng yīnyuèhuì ba: Let's go to a concert.
cards.Notes: 音乐 music (乐 yuè here, not lè) + 会 gathering

cards.Example: 北京的秋天很美。 Běijīng de qiūtiān hěn měi: Autumn in Beijing is beautiful.
cards.Notes: 秋 = 禾 grain + 火 fire, harvest time; + 天 season

cards.Example: 我们去海边玩吧。 wǒmen qù hǎibiān wánr ba: Let's go to the beach.
cards.Notes: 海 sea + 边 side

cards.Example: 天晴了。 tiān qíng le: It's cleared up.
cards.Notes: 日 sun + 青 qīng (phonetic); compare 请 and 情

cards.Example: 里头有人吗？ lǐtou yǒu rén ma: Is anyone in there?
cards.Notes: 里 in + 头 side (toneless suffix)

cards.Example: 今天我请客。 jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè: It's on me today.
cards.Notes: 请 invite + 客 guest = invite guests, so you pay

cards.Example: 他每天看日报。 tā měi tiān kàn rìbào: He reads the daily paper every day.
cards.Notes: 日 day + 报 newspaper

cards.Example: 我有点儿累。 wǒ yǒudiǎnr lèi: I'm a bit tired.
cards.Notes: 有 have + 点儿 a bit

cards.Example: 来，干杯！ lái, gānbēi: Come on, cheers!
cards.Notes: 干 gān dry + 杯 cup = dry the cup; 干 is gàn in 干活

cards.Example: 今天是晴天。 jīntiān shì qíngtiān: It's sunny today.
cards.Notes: 晴 = 日 sun + 青 qīng for the sound

cards.Example: 那会儿我还小。 nàhuìr wǒ hái xiǎo: I was little back then.
cards.Notes: 那 that + 会儿 a while = that moment

cards.Example: 祝你一路顺风！ zhù nǐ yílùshùnfēng: Have a good trip!
cards.Notes: 一路 whole way + 顺风 wind at your back

cards.Example: 我爸爱看晚报。 wǒ bà ài kàn wǎnbào: My dad loves the evening paper.
cards.Notes: 晚 evening + 报 newspaper

cards.Example: 我们找人问路吧。 wǒmen zhǎo rén wènlù ba: Let's ask someone for directions.
cards.Notes: 问 ask + 路 road

cards.Example: 这个词有两个音节。 zhège cí yǒu liǎng ge yīnjié: This word has two syllables.
cards.Notes: 音 sound + 节 section = a section of sound

cards.Example: 我只喝一点点。 wǒ zhǐ hē yìdiǎndiǎn: I'll just have a tiny bit.
cards.Notes: 一点 a bit, with 点 doubled for "tiny"

cards.Example: 春节你回家吗？ Chūnjié nǐ huí jiā ma: Are you going home for Spring Festival?
cards.Notes: 春 spring + 节 festival

cards.Example: 今天是阴天。 jīntiān shì yīntiān: It's overcast today.
cards.Notes: 阴 overcast + 天 day; opposite of 晴天

cards.Example: 这个字的读音是什么？ zhège zì de dúyīn shì shénme: How is this character pronounced?
cards.Notes: 读 read aloud + 音 sound

cards.Example: 祝你一路平安。 zhù nǐ yílùpíng'ān: Have a safe trip.
cards.Notes: 一路 whole way + 平安 safe and sound

cards.Example: 不一会儿他就来了。 bùyíhuìr tā jiù lái le: He showed up shortly after.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 一会儿 a while = not even a while

cards.Example: 他在外面干活儿。 tā zài wàimiàn gànhuór: He's working outside.
cards.Notes: 干 gàn do + 活儿 work; 干 is gān in 干杯

cards.Example: 我不太饿。 wǒ bútài è: I'm not very hungry.
cards.Notes: 不 not + 太 too, very

cards.Example: 墙上有张画儿。 qiáng shang yǒu zhāng huàr: There's a picture on the wall.
cards.Notes: 画 picture + 儿 erhua ending
